scope: Read-only current-source audit of the 11 assigned money screens and payment/refund/payout/payout_transfers lifecycles. No implementation, money operation, production request, test, build, installation, commit, push or deployment was performed.
evidenceRules: All sourceRefs are repository-relative paths and line ranges at the frozen SHA. Draft doc 18 supplies proposed WP/flag ownership, not evidence of implemented behavior.
Defects below are source-proven reachable conditions, not claims that a live customer experienced them. All proposed tests are NOT RUN.

The coordinator attested application-code parity between supplied web artifact head 229995fe3194de39684f12ef348d3e37930ae5f2 and the audit SHA. The hosted run's failure is not used as evidence of an application defect.

Only 119-earnings.png, 120-earnings-scrolled.png and 142-dark-earnings.png were visually inspected. A visible DEMO DATA badge is not proof of any runtime flag value or of the provenance of each displayed payout.
Money arithmetic, cancellation/refund policy, commission, tax and release rules are preserved. No new order engine, universal status enum, financial action or staff finance permission is proposed.

screens.purpose: Owner's recorded provider/venue payouts, timing, commission information and statement entry; not a withdrawal or bank-settlement command.
currentHierarchy: Payout account / next payout / optional statement
targetHierarchy: Pending / recorded transfer / hold / problem summaries with explicit scope
Payout-verification context and full next-release text
Statement entry when its existing capability is ON
screens.primaryAction: Open the relevant existing booking or monthly statement; no provider retry/withdraw action.
roleStateCases: Provider owner: own provider_id rows remain readable with provider_earnings_statement OFF.
Venue payee: payee_id-only rows require provider_earnings_statement; being a venue manager/staff member does not confer ownership.
A manager/staff tab is hidden by the provider layout; deep-link reads still use the caller UID, not the business owner's UID.
pending is not transferred; failed is a payment problem; frozen is a hold; demo is excluded from financial totals. Session-demo misclassification is MN-F02.

placement.current: First elevated card, before all operational context; week/four-week calculation uses payout created_at.
placement.problemOrRetain: Retain both existing periods and exact stored-paise sums; the chart dominates before payout readiness, while the following summaries are all-time.
placement.target: Compact first section with period-labelled recorded earnings; explicitly mark operational summaries as all-time. Keep chart secondary within this section.
placement.reason: Do not imply that changing the chart period filters every payout/summary below.

placement.current: Two mini-cards immediately below the chart; transferred payout amounts are labelled Paid to bank.
placement.problemOrRetain: transferred can mean gateway dispatch or complete receivable netting, not confirmed bank credit.
placement.target: Keep the exact stored totals but label the transferred bucket Transfer recorded / offset; never infer bank credit from payout.status or transferred_at alone.
placement.reason: Separate internal payout record, transfer dispatch, gateway processed state and bank confirmation.

placement.current: Second mini-card row; frozen and failed remain separate from pending and transferred.
placement.problemOrRetain: Retain this distinction and the existing honest failure wording; elevate a nonzero problem/hold before secondary terms.
placement.target: Directly under the period summary, before commission information; contextual link scrolls to the affected existing rows rather than offering an owner retry.
placement.reason: Important problems must be discoverable without inventing a financial permission.

placement.current: Large TierCard precedes account/readiness and statement links; default standard and session terms come from get_commission_terms.
placement.problemOrRetain: Retain server terms, founding-period calculation and unavailable state. This is explanatory, not the next payout action.
placement.target: After payout readiness/history entry, in a secondary section; label standard-job terms as defaults, not a quotation for every fixed/proposal booking.
placement.reason: Preserve policy without making a generic tier card appear to override booking snapshots/category overrides.

placement.current: After TierCard; linked/verified requires both provider.razorpay_account_id and kyc_status=verified; all non-rejected alternatives say Verification pending.
placement.problemOrRetain: A verified RazorpayX provider with a fund account but no Route account is incorrectly called pending; clarification/suspended states are also collapsed.
placement.target: Show the actual gateway verification state from provider.kyc_status, with Manage payout details as a contextual link. Do not equate this badge with eligibility of every pending transfer.

compositeRules.rule: Eligibility is composite and rail-specific
compositeRules.current: Claim requires child pending, due retry/release times, parent pending and release due, non-demo captured source, no service booking dispute, and a valid destination under the actual rail. compositeRules.rule: Dispatch, gateway processed and bank-credit proof differ
compositeRules.current: Rail returns gatewayStatus but release-payouts discards it and calls complete_transfer using external ID only. compositeRules.rule: Amounts and recovery are separate facts
compositeRules.current: claim returns amount=transfer.amount-_net_receivables and gross_amount=stored tranche amount. Full netting calls complete_transfer with netted_ reference and no gateway dispatch. Reversed_amount is updated after reversal completion, not after customer refund submission.

compositeRules.rule: Route reversal is not RazorpayX collection
compositeRules.current: Route queues an external reversal. RazorpayX cannot pull the money back and records provider debt/recovery where supported. A venue payee with null provider_id gets a debt_recorded diagnostic saying operator action is required, not an actual provider_receivables row.

The gateway may reject over-refunding; actual overpayment is unverified.

On failure, change no refund/payment/audit rows; return a clear capacity-already-reserved error. Do not clamp an authorized refund to a new policy amount.
